$comment: Who edits which code. Read by production/scripts/areas.mjs and every Claude session. Longest matching prefix wins. 1 Oct 2026 (Pardeep): app code is written from ONE branch (manager-pardeep) by Pardeep + AI so nothing collides; Pawan keeps the website paths; Abhishek deploy/CI; Hitesh checks money numbers and writes no code. Need a change elsewhere? Card for Pardeep on the board.

pardeep.name: Pardeep

abhishek.name: Abhishek

pawan.name: Pawan

shared.$comment: Nobody owns these alone. Change the smallest thing that works, run the full gate, and post a 'changes' entry on the board naming who is affected.
